type Id<T> = { v: T }['v'];
type Second<T> = { first: string; second: T }['second'];
type Property<O, K extends keyof O> = O[K];
interface Box<T> {
  v: T;
  w: string;
}
function viaAlias<T extends Id<T>>() {}
function viaSecond<T extends Second<T>>() {}
function viaInterface<T extends Box<T>['v']>() {}
function viaArguments<T extends Property<{ v: T }, 'v'>>() {}
function viaIndex<T extends { [k: string]: T }['x']>() {}
function viaTuple<T extends [T][0]>() {}
function viaKeys<T extends { v: T; w: number }['v' | 'w']>() {}
function viaNested<T extends { v: { u: T } }['v']['u']>() {}
function viaOptional<T extends { v?: T }['v']>() {}
function viaArray<T extends { v: T[] }['v']>() {}
function viaOther<T extends Box<T>['w']>() {}
function viaNumber<T extends { 0: T }[0]>() {}
console.log('ready');
